artifact_type: AI-reviewed source reference cases; NOT application test results

label_meaning.supported: This specific guide supports the narrow document question.
label_meaning.conditional: Relevant source requires explicit limits; it does not decide personal eligibility.
label_meaning.insufficient: No sufficient basis for the requested conclusion in this guide, even when related text exists.

cases.question: 首次申请从哪里进入，需要实名吗？
cases.locator: 第二部分 > 第一步：开始备案
cases.reason: The guide describes an entry route and identity verification.
cases.must_not_infer: Do not invent other login routes or current interface changes.

cases.question: 申请提交后在哪里看办理进度？
cases.locator: 第二部分 > 第四步：查看备案进度
cases.reason: The progress-viewing entry is explicitly described.
cases.must_not_infer: Viewing progress is not evidence of approval.

cases.question: 页面默认的参保地能调整吗？
cases.locator: 第二部分 > 第二步：选择备案类型
cases.reason: The guide allows adjustment according to actual circumstances.
cases.must_not_infer: Do not claim insurance enrollment has been transferred.

cases.question: 交不出认定材料，可以改用个人承诺申请吗？
cases.locator: 第二部分 > 第三步：提交备案材料
cases.reason: Only some regions and eligible people unable to submit recognition materials are described.
cases.must_not_infer: Preserve all three limits; applying does not mean approval.

cases.question: 全国任何地区都能只签承诺书、不交认定材料吗？
cases.locator: 第二部分 > 第三步：提交备案材料
cases.reason: A limited regional route cannot support a nationwide guarantee.
cases.must_not_infer: A relevant paragraph alone is not sufficient support for the requested conclusion.

cases.question: 我这次住院具体能报销百分之多少？
cases.reason: The guide provides no personal reimbursement rate or calculation inputs.
cases.must_not_infer: Do not infer a percentage from a reimbursement-related title.

cases.question: 今天提交备案，今天一定审批通过吗？
cases.locator: 第二部分 > 第三步、第四步
cases.reason: Submission and progress lookup do not establish a processing deadline.
cases.must_not_infer: Real-time progress lookup does not mean immediate approval.

cases.question: 替父母代办必须准备身份证、户口本还是委托书？
